# Fish Audio S2 TTS

## Auto-Download

**Models auto-download on first run** - no manual setup needed!

| Model | VRAM | Size |
|-------|------|------|
| s2-pro (bf16) | ~24GB | ~10GB |
| s2-pro-fp8 | ~20GB | ~8GB |
| s2-pro-BNB-int8 | ~20GB | ~10GB |
| s2-pro-BNB-nf4 | ~16GB  | ~10GB  |
---

## Manual Download

| File | Size | Link |
|------|------|------|
| s2-pro (Full) | ~10GB | [Download](https://huggingface.co/fishaudio/s2-pro) |
| s2-pro-fp8 | ~8GB | [Download](https://huggingface.co/drbaph/s2-pro-fp8) |


Place in:
```
ComfyUI/models/FishAudioS2/
├── s2-pro/
│   ├── config.json
│   ├── model.safetensors
│   └── ...
└── s2-pro-fp8/
    ├── config.json
    ├── model.safetensors
    └── ...
```

---

## BNB Model use the s2-pro model as base and quantise on the fly using bitsandbytes

---

## Common tags (15,000+ unique tags supported):

## [pause] [emphasis] [laughing] [inhale] [chuckle] [tsk] [singing] [excited] [laughing tone] [interrupting] [chuckling] [excited tone] [volume up] [echo] [angry] [low volume] [sigh] [low voice] [whisper] [screaming] [shouting] [loud] [surprised] [short pause] [exhale] [delight] [panting] [audience laughter] [with strong accent] [volume down] [clearing throat] [sad] [moaning] [shocked]

---

## LTX-2.3 Prompting Tips

1. **Core Actions**: Describe events and actions as they occur over time  
2. **Visual Details**: Describe all visual details you want to appear in the video  
3. **Audio**: Describe sounds and dialogue needed for the scene

## Report LTX-2.3 Issues
To report any issues when running this workflow, [go to GitHub](https://github.com/Lightricks/ComfyUI-LTXVideo/issues)

古风雪景，木屋庭院，大雪纷飞，窗内暖黄灯火。女子身披纯白狐狸毛大氅，毛绒帽兜罩头；男子身穿深褐色粗布棉袄，怀中抱柴火，腰间别斧。

**【0-1秒】** 女子仰头贴近男子肩头，眼神娇嗔撒娇，嘴唇微张作询问状（台词："你叫我狐狸？"）。镜头从双人腰部中景缓慢前推至女子面部特写，**焦点对焦在女子脸上**，捕捉她歪头撒娇时的眼波流转与询问神态，嘴角微撅似在等待回答。

**【1-3秒】** **焦点快速切换至男子脸部**，他面对女主眼神害羞，尴尬低语（台词："对不起，应该是白狐夫人"），耳根微红，表情窘迫又宠溺。浅景深背景虚化，特写他歉意的眼神。

**【3-8秒】** **焦点快速转回对焦女子**，她眼眶瞬间泛红，嘴唇微颤，开始委屈诉说（台词："以前陪我在雪山吃酱板鸭的时候，叫人家小狐狐……"）。镜头保持女子面部特写，捕捉她情绪转变的微表情。

**【8-12秒】** **镜头缓缓后拉至双人半身中景**，男主故作娇羞状。女子继续诉说未完台词（"……现在你有酱板鸭了，叫人家白狐夫人"），眼眶泛红，嘴唇微颤；男子目光由窘迫转为温柔疼惜，全程雪花飘落，情绪由甜转虐，电影级光影，24fps。
